articles.title: I built an MCP server that gives AI agents exact, high-precision finance math
articles.description: LLMs are shockingly bad at arithmetic. Ask an agent to chain a CAC payback with a churn-adjusted LTV, convert it to EUR, and discount three years of cash flows, and you will get an answer that looks right and is quietly wrong. Floating point, dropped steps, and confident hallucination are a bad comb
articles.content: LLMs are shockingly bad at arithmetic. Ask an agent to chain a CAC payback with a churn-adjusted LTV, convert it to EUR, and discount three years of cash flows, and you will get an answer that looks right and is quietly wrong. Floating point, dropped steps, and confident hallucination are a bad combination when the output is a number someone makes a decision on. So I built PrecisionCalc MCP — a deterministic Model Context Protocol server that gives AI agents a calculator they can actually trust.
articles.author: DatanestDigital
